strategy: Independently phrased factual rules; no bundled wiki articles, game assets or private saves.

rules.location: Emerald Grove / Secluded Cove (north-east of the ritual circle)
rules.trigger: Approach the singing at the Secluded Cove and speak to Mirkon.
prerequisites: Mirkon must still be alive
The grove/refugee situation must not have closed this encounter
rules.recommended_before: Resolve immediately once the encounter starts; check before resolving the grove or entering Mountain Pass.
cautions: Do not assume each long rest progresses the whole grove; Mirkon's encounter has its own local trigger.
Wiki marks the camp-travel claim as needing verification; no precise rest countdown is inferred from a save.

rules.location: Emerald Grove / Druid's Chambers; Putrid Bog island
rules.trigger: Read the note in Kagha's chest; find the second letter in the large tree on the swamp island, then confront her.
prerequisites: Grove access
The goblin-leader resolution has not already ended the investigation branch
rules.recommended_before: Confront Kagha before killing or knocking out all three goblin leaders and before the Mountain Pass transition.
cautions: Killing all goblin leaders can auto-resolve the journal while skipping the Shadow Druid confrontation and its rewards.

rules.location: Emerald Grove / Druid's Chambers
rules.trigger: Speak to Arabella's parents at the Sacred Pool entrance, then intervene in Kagha's judgement.
prerequisites: Arabella must still be alive
The judgement has not ended in her death
rules.recommended_before: Resolve the judgement while present, before progressing the grove conflict.

rules.location: Waukeen's Rest / burning inn upstairs
rules.trigger: Remove the beam trapping Benryn, lead him outside, then investigate his wife's dowry.
prerequisites: Benryn must still be alive
The fire rescue must not have expired after approaching the inn
rules.recommended_before: Once Waukeen's Rest is approached, rescue survivors before leaving or long resting.
cautions: The source describes an exception if at least one party member remains nearby; the analyzer cannot reconstruct travel timing from absent flags.

rules.quest: Rescue Counsellor Florrick at Waukeen's Rest
rules.quest_zh: 沃金休眠地营救弗洛瑞克
rules.location: Waukeen's Rest / burning inn north upstairs room
rules.trigger: Help the Flaming Fists enter the inn and break the upstairs door to free Florrick.
prerequisites: Florrick must still be alive
rules.recommended_before: Rescue immediately after approaching Waukeen's Rest, before rest, travel or Mountain Pass.
cautions: This result covers the Act One fire rescue only. Losing Florrick does not prove the multi-act Grand Duke quest is impossible.

rules.location: Emerald Grove; Goblin Camp
rules.trigger: Speak with Zevlor and resolve the threat to the refugees and grove.
prerequisites: The refugee population and grove outcome still permit a rescue
rules.recommended_before: Finish the grove outcome and its camp celebration before entering Rosymorn Monastery Trail or the Shadow-Cursed Lands.
cautions: Normal long rests alone do not finish the Rite of Thorns. Mountain Pass is still Act One but advances the grove plot.

rules.location: Riverside Teahouse / Overgrown Tunnel / Ancient Abode
rules.trigger: Investigate the teahouse, follow Ethel underground, protect Mayrina's cage and resolve Ethel's offer.
prerequisites: Mayrina is alive and the Act One encounter has not ended without her release
rules.recommended_before: Resolve the encounter before leaving the first-act maps permanently.
cautions: Receiving the hag's hair can coexist with saving Mayrina; the reward alone does not prove her rescue or death.

rules.quest_zh: 解救鬼婆的面具受害者
rules.location: Overgrown Tunnel
rules.trigger: Keep the victims alive and end Ethel's control; speak to the survivors after the encounter.
prerequisites: Victims survive
For the vanilla liberation outcome, Ethel must be killed in Act One
rules.recommended_before: Choose the desired hag outcome before bargaining; surviving or becoming neutral alone does not complete liberation.
mutually_exclusive: Preserving Ethel alive after her bargain versus the ordinary liberation route
cautions: Only Mask of Regret fully recovers sanity. Removing a mask while Ethel is alive is dangerous.
A repair/mod can make actors alive and neutral without setting the liberation storyline.

rules.location: Blighted Village blacksmith basement; Sussur Tree in the Underdark
rules.trigger: Read the blacksmith's notes, collect Sussur Bark, then use the basement forge with a suitable plain weapon.
prerequisites: Access to the first-act surface and Underdark
Sussur Bark and a supported plain weapon
rules.recommended_before: Complete before entering the Shadowfell, which ends access to Act One areas.

rules.location: Risen Road gnoll cave; Zhentarim Hideout below Waukeen's Rest
rules.trigger: Investigate the gnoll attack and recover the locked shipment; speak to Zarys in the hideout.
prerequisites: An intact chest is needed for the ordinary delivery reward branch
rules.recommended_before: Resolve your chosen delivery branch before first-act areas become inaccessible.
mutually_exclusive: Opening the shipment versus delivering it unopened to Zarys
cautions: An opened chest closes the ordinary intact-delivery branch; it does not prove every associated encounter was missed.

rules.location: Blighted Village windmill
rules.trigger: Deal with the goblins, use the brake lever to stop the windmill, then untie Barcus.
prerequisites: Barcus must survive the windmill encounter
rules.recommended_before: Check the windmill during your Act One exploration.
cautions: Brake and release-brake levers produce different outcomes.

rules.location: Dammon's forge in Emerald Grove (Act One), then Last Light Inn (Act Two)
rules.trigger: Bring Karlach and Infernal Iron to Dammon; return for the second engine upgrade in Act Two.
prerequisites: Karlach recruited
Dammon survives
Infernal Iron
rules.recommended_before: Protect Dammon and finish the second upgrade before ending Act Two.
cautions: WaitForNextAct means the first-act upgrade is done and the next stage is gated; it does not complete Karlach's whole companion quest.

rules.location: Camp celebration (Act One); Last Light Inn / camp (Act Two)
rules.trigger: Talk to Karlach during the tiefling celebration and choose her romance; later finish both engine upgrades and the relationship scene.
prerequisites: Companion Karlach recruited
Vanilla celebration initiation needs at least 20 approval and compatible other relationships
Dammon available for upgrades
rules.recommended_before: Check the celebration before leaving Act One and the second romance scene before leaving Act Two.
cautions: Wiki currently reports the alternate Act One night confession is bugged without mods; patch and mod changes must be checked live.
Romance flags are scoped: the report must not assign another player's romance to the host.
Polyamory and romance-fix mods can invalidate vanilla exclusivity checks; absence of dating flags is not a permanent-loss verdict.

rules.location: Goblin Camp / Shattered Sanctum / Worg Pens
rules.trigger: Find the imprisoned bear in the Worg Pens and resolve the goblin threat.
prerequisites: Halsin must survive
Grove/goblin branch permits his rescue
rules.recommended_before: Resolve before taking the Mountain Pass or entering Act Two.

rules.location: Moonrise Towers Prison; Last Light Inn
rules.trigger: Speak to Wulbren in prison, provide a bludgeoning tool or break the rear wall, and escort the escape.
prerequisites: Wulbren survives
The Moonrise prison rescue window remains open
rules.recommended_before: Rescue prisoners before entering the Shadowfell / resolving Ketheric's relic.

rules.location: Last Light Inn; Moonrise Towers Prison
rules.trigger: Ask the refugees at Last Light about the prisoners, free them at Moonrise and reunite them at the inn.
prerequisites: The Act One refugees were protected
Prisoners still survive
The Shadowfell cutoff has not passed
rules.recommended_before: Rescue before entering Shadowfell; collect reunion rewards before leaving Act Two.
cautions: Some prisoners escaping does not prove all prisoners survived or all reward reunions were completed.

rules.location: Last Light Inn; lakeside portal; Oliver's house
rules.trigger: Investigate Art Cullagh, inform Halsin, defend his portal and reunite Thaniel with Oliver.
prerequisites: Halsin available
Reunite Thaniel and Oliver and defeat Ketheric
rules.recommended_before: Finish the curse-resolution steps before permanently departing Act Two.
cautions: Some steps remain possible after the Moonrise battle. Do not reuse the prisoner Shadowfell cutoff for this entire quest.

rules.location: Wyrm's Rock Prison
rules.trigger: Read an execution notice or learn about her from Ravengard; locate and escort her out of prison.
prerequisites: Florrick survived the first-act fire
The execution deadline has not elapsed
rules.recommended_before: After the notice/coronation trigger, rescue within five long rests; do it promptly when started.
cautions: Learning the quest from Ravengard in camp is documented as not starting the same timer; the analyzer does not fabricate a remaining-rest count.

rules.location: Steel Watch Foundry; Iron Throne
rules.trigger: Speak with Toobin and rescue the Iron Throne hostages before finishing the foundry operation.
prerequisites: The foundry and Iron Throne are accessible
Gortash has not already caused their destruction
rules.recommended_before: Visit the Iron Throne before destroying the foundry; finish rescues before killing Gortash.

rules.location: Waukeen's Rest; Moonrise; Wyrm's Rock; Iron Throne
rules.trigger: Follow Ravengard's captors. In Act Three attend the coronation, speak with Mizora and arrange the rescue.
prerequisites: Follow the correct coronation/Mizora sequence for the ordinary Iron Throne rescue
rules.recommended_before: Attend the coronation and speak with Mizora before visiting the Iron Throne or finishing the Steel Watch operation.
cautions: Breaking Wyll's pact is not by itself proof that Ravengard cannot be rescued. Some death states have a resurrection branch.
